motifs.Plus assez de magie ({n} / {n}). Elle re: Not enough magic ({n} / {n}). It comes back on its own; one of Gustave's magic potions restores it at once.

textes.(bâton de sorcier en main : chaque sort: (wizard's staff in hand: every spell costs 1 less)
textes.+2 d'endurance par point : courir, roule: +2 stamina per point: run, roll and climb for longer.
textes.+4 % de vitesse, une roulade plus longue: +4% speed, a longer roll, stamina that comes back faster.
textes.Après un coup d'arme, garde le clic enfo: After a weapon blow, keep the button held: the blade charges up (it glows). Release: a terrible blow (×2.5). In VR: a very fast swing.
textes.Arbre marqué d'une entaille : il s'abat: Tree marked with a notch: chop it down with an axe
textes.Aucun pour l'instant. Rendez service, et: None yet. Help people out, and they will remember it.
textes.Aucune pour l'instant. La première t'att: None yet. The first one may be waiting for you under the village…
textes.Aucune quête en cours. Parlez aux habita: No quest in progress. Talk to the locals: many of them need help.
textes.Chaque pouvoir lancé rend de l'endurance: Every power you cast gives back stamina; every four powers, half a heart.
textes.Charge plus longtemps (la lueur devient: Charge longer (the glow turns blue): when you release, you spin and strike all around you, twice. In VR: click the right stick.
textes.Charger remplace la partie en cours : pe: Loading replaces the current game: remember to save first.
textes.Choisis un talent pour le lire. Les tale: Pick a talent to read it. The talents of a branch are learned in order, from top to bottom.
textes.Courir coûte deux fois moins d'endurance: Running costs half the stamina, and you run 10% faster.
textes.Deux cœurs rendus ; le sort soigne aussi: Two hearts restored; the spell also heals wounded creatures.
textes.Faites glisser pour déplacer, molette po: Drag to move, mouse wheel to zoom.
textes.L'objet que tu vises, même hors de porté: The item you aim at, even out of reach, flies into your hand.
textes.La Flamme brûle plus fort, la Bourrasque: The Flame burns hotter, the Gust blows wider, the Moonglow lasts longer, the Cog turns longer.
textes.La première t'attend peut-être sous le v: The first one may be waiting for you under the village…
textes.La télékinésie ne trouve rien à attraper: Telekinesis finds nothing to grab over there.
textes.Le dernier coup d'un enchaînement frappe: The last blow of a combo hits twice as hard, and every blow has a one-in-eight chance to be critical.
textes.Les coups qui enlèvent un cœur ou plus p: Blows that take a heart or more lose half a heart.
textes.Les pouvoirs des sceaux se rechargent 30: Seal powers recharge 30% faster. (You need at least one seal.)
textes.Lève ta garde (F, ou grip gauche en VR): Raise your guard (F, or left grip in VR) at the last moment, just before the blow: no damage, the enemy is stunned and your riposte hits double.
textes.Manette : croix ou stick pour viser: Controller: d-pad or stick to aim
textes.Mode PC classique — F11 plein écran • F6: Classic PC mode — F11 full screen • F6 ultra sharpness (GPU) • no headset needed.
textes.OpenXR absent. Relance en activant Meta: OpenXR missing. Restart with Meta Quest Link or SteamVR turned on.
textes.OpenXR non connecté. Entre d'abord dans: OpenXR not connected. First enter Quest Link on the headset, then press R.
textes.PC : 1 à 4 pour choisir un pouvoir, X po: PC: 1 to 4 to choose a power, X to cast it. VR: B to cast, hold B to switch.
textes.PC : 5 à 0 pour choisir un sort, V pour: PC: 5 to 0 to choose a spell, V to cast it, B for the next one. VR: left trigger to cast, hold it to switch.
textes.Pendant la roulade (Ctrl), les coups pas: During the roll (Ctrl), blows pass right through you. It goes further and costs less stamina. In VR: click the left stick to dodge.
textes.Pense très fort à un lieu que tu as déjà: Think hard about a place you have already seen… and you'll be there. Choose your destination:
textes.Personne ici… pour l'instant. Allez salu: Nobody here… for now. Go and say hello to the locals!
Pick up items on the island with E.
textes.Redémarrage impossible : ferme l'applica: Cannot restart: close the app and launch the EXE again after Quest Link.
textes.Rien en vue pour l'instant. Explorez, re: Nothing in sight for now. Explore, meet people!
You don't have any seal power yet.
textes.Tu ne connais encore aucun sort. Les maî: You don't know any spell yet. The masters of Arcanelle, the wizards' island, teach six of them.
textes.Tu t'élèves de cinq ou six mètres, tu pl: You rise five or six metres, hover a moment, and float gently back down.
textes.Un second saut en plein vol (Espace, ou: A second jump in mid-air (Space, or A in VR, a second time in the air).
textes.Un souffle de mécanique : il remet en ma: A mechanical breath: it restarts old mechanisms from afar and paralyses automatons.
textes.Un souffle glacé : les ennemis se figent: An icy breath: enemies freeze; on a lake, a path of ice.
textes.Un vent du large qui repousse les ennemi: A sea wind that pushes enemies back, flips shells over, turns sails and windmills.
textes.Une boule de feu : elle brûle les ennemi: A fireball: it burns enemies and brambles, lights braziers and torches.
textes.Une boule de feu qui file droit devant :: A fireball that flies straight ahead: it burns enemies and lights braziers and torches.
A ball of light follows you for a minute. It lights up the dark and wakes sleeping runes.
textes.Une fois toutes les dix minutes, un coup: Once every ten minutes, a blow that should knock you out leaves you at half a heart.
textes.Une lumière de lune autour de toi : elle: Moonlight around you: it reveals what is hidden (bridges, slabs, writings) and makes ghosts vulnerable.
textes.Vide. Gâchette près d'un objet pour le r: Empty. Trigger near an item to pick it up.
textes.Visez avec la main droite, gâchette pour: Aim with your right hand, trigger to click, stick to scroll
textes.Visez un objet et appuyez sur la gâchett: Aim at an item and press the trigger, then “Use” or “Drop”
textes.approchez un ponton ou une plage pour dé: get close to a pier or a beach to go ashore
textes.Énigmes, gardiens, portes, quêtes, coffr: Riddles, guardians, doors, quests, hidden chests: the hero grows by overcoming them.
